import * as THREE from 'three';
import {createXiqingSurface} from '../../../controls/XiqingRoofSurface.js';
/** Source-visible exterior objects, not an inferred interior inventory or
 * identification of alloy, date, ritual function or original animal carving. */
export function addYanchunSouthVessels(c){
 const {f,item,p,kit}=c;
 if(p.key!=='yanchun'||item.x!==216||item.z!==485.5||item.w!==23.5||item.d!==24.3||f.position.x!==216||f.position.y!==0||f.position.z!==485.5||f.rotation.toArray().slice(0,3).some(Boolean)||f.scale.toArray().some(x=>x!==1)||f.userData.r144YanchunVessels)throw Error('R144 Yanchun vessel binding mismatch');
 const md={originalObjectId:'FC-12BEB1BB0E',source:'https://img.dpm.org.cn/Uploads/Picture/2020/04/20/s5e9d41b19d7f7.jpg',photographyDate:null,scope:'SOUTH_STAIR_TWO_HANDLED_TRIPOD_DARK_VESSELS_AND_STONE_BASES',material:'DARK_METAL_APPEARANCE_ALLOY_DATE_AND_USE_UNVERIFIED',dimensions:'PHOTO_RELATIONSHIP_FIT_NOT_SURVEYED',wholeObjectAccepted:false,residual:['Fine relief and feet carving','Exact ear curvature and underside','Whole interior inventory','Upper south deep apron blocked by retained roof interface; rejected shallow candidate absent']};
 const dark=new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({name:'r144-yanchun-dark-metal-fit',color:0x303d39,roughness:.74,metalness:.3});kit.owned.push(dark);
 function clean(raw){const p=raw.attributes.position,ix=raw.index,n=raw.attributes.normal,u=raw.attributes.uv,ps=[],ns=[],uv=[];for(let i=0;i<(ix?.count??p.count);i+=3){const ids=[0,1,2].map(k=>ix?ix.getX(i+k):i+k),v=ids.map(j=>new THREE.Vector3().fromBufferAttribute(p,j));if(v[1].clone().sub(v[0]).cross(v[2].clone().sub(v[0])).lengthSq()<1e-14)continue;for(const j of ids){ps.push(p.getX(j),p.getY(j),p.getZ(j));ns.push(n.getX(j),n.getY(j),n.getZ(j));uv.push(u?.getX(j)??0,u?.getY(j)??0);}}raw.dispose();const g=new THREE.BufferGeometry();g.setAttribute('position',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(ps,3));g.setAttribute('normal',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(ns,3));g.setAttribute('uv',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(uv,2));return g;}
 for(const sign of[-1,1]){
  const x=sign*5.8,z=-14.3,side=sign<0?'east':'west';let index=0;
  function add(role,geometry,material,position,quaternion=null){const m=kit.mesh(f,clean(geometry),material,...position);if(quaternion)m.quaternion.copy(quaternion);m.name='r144-yanchun-'+role;m.userData.r144YanchunVessel=md;m.updateWorldMatrix(true,false);const a=m.geometry.attributes.position,faces=[];for(let i=0;i<a.count;i+=3)faces.push({source:{mesh:f.children.indexOf(m),triangle:i/3},vertices:[0,1,2].map(k=>new THREE.Vector3().fromBufferAttribute(a,i+k).applyMatrix4(m.matrixWorld))});const id=`yanchun-front-vessel-${side}-${index++}`,surface=createXiqingSurface(faces,id),col=surface.box.clone();col.xiqingRoofSurface=surface;col.r144YanchunVessel=true;if(role==='bowl')col.furnitureMotionScope={kind:'yanchun-front-vessels',id,groundY:0,minOffsetX:item.x+x-1.9-col.min.x,maxOffsetX:item.x+x+1.9-col.min.x,minOffsetZ:item.z+z-2-col.min.z,maxOffsetZ:item.z+z+1.1-col.min.z};kit.colliders.push(col);m.userData.r144Contact=id;return m;}
  for(const [r0,r1,h,y]of[[.88,.91,.12,.06],[.77,.82,.14,.19],[.79,.77,.08,.30]])add('stone-base',new THREE.CylinderGeometry(r0,r1,h,8),kit.lib.material('stone_slab'),[x,y,z]);
  const profile=[[0,0],[.35,0],[.46,.06],[.61,.20],[.66,.37],[.62,.53],[.68,.56],[.68,.63],[.55,.63],[.55,.54],[.57,.38],[.48,.23],[.32,.14],[0,.14]];
  add('bowl',new THREE.LatheGeometry(profile.map(p=>new THREE.Vector2(...p)),36),dark,[x,.73,z]);
  for(let i=0;i<3;i++){const theta=Math.PI+i*2*Math.PI/3,unit=new THREE.Vector3(Math.sin(theta),0,Math.cos(theta)),lo=unit.clone().multiplyScalar(.51).add(new THREE.Vector3(x,.43,z)),hi=unit.clone().multiplyScalar(.39).add(new THREE.Vector3(x,.82,z)),dir=hi.clone().sub(lo),q=new THREE.Quaternion().setFromUnitVectors(new THREE.Vector3(0,1,0),dir.clone().normalize());add('leg',new THREE.CylinderGeometry(.10,.125,dir.length(),12),dark,lo.clone().add(hi).multiplyScalar(.5).toArray(),q);const foot=new THREE.SphereGeometry(.15,12,8);foot.scale(1,.62,1.12);add('foot',foot,dark,[lo.x,.427,lo.z]);}
  for(const s of[-1,1]){const shape=new THREE.Shape();shape.moveTo(-.06,0);shape.lineTo(.08,0);shape.bezierCurveTo(.20,.18,.22,.42,.20,.58);shape.bezierCurveTo(.35,.68,.31,.82,.15,.80);shape.bezierCurveTo(-.05,.80,-.16,.72,-.09,.60);shape.bezierCurveTo(.03,.44,.02,.18,-.06,0);shape.closePath();const hole=new THREE.Path();hole.moveTo(.045,.22);hole.bezierCurveTo(.08,.35,.11,.49,.105,.60);hole.bezierCurveTo(.17,.69,.19,.72,.13,.72);hole.bezierCurveTo(.01,.72,-.015,.67,.025,.61);hole.bezierCurveTo(.07,.46,.065,.34,.045,.22);hole.closePath();shape.holes.push(hole);let geo=new THREE.ExtrudeGeometry(shape,{depth:.11,curveSegments:5,bevelEnabled:false,steps:1});geo.translate(0,0,-.055);const q=new THREE.Quaternion().setFromAxisAngle(new THREE.Vector3(0,1,0),s===1?0:Math.PI);add('ear',geo,dark,[x+s*.55,1.13,z],q);}
  if(index!==12)throw Error('R144 finite source surface count mismatch');
 }
 f.userData.r144YanchunVessels=md;return md;
}
